Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that Ambroise Thomas is primarily an operetta composer, citing Mignon and Hamlet as operettas. Both are operas (French opéra comique/lyrique), and Thomas is recognized as an opera composer. This misclassification (and claiming “the search confirmed” without evidence from WebSurfer) led to the wrong final conclusion.
